description: Source code for Windows network interface utilities in Chromium project, including functions to retrieve network interface list, connection attributes, and Wi-Fi details.

classes.name: WifiOptionSetter
classes.description: Manages Wi-Fi interface options such as scan and streaming mode.

methods.name: GetNetworkInterfaceType
methods.description: Converts Windows interface type to internal network connection type.

methods.name: GetNetworkListImpl
methods.description: Populates network list from adapter info.

methods.name: GetNetworkList
methods.description: Retrieves list of network interfaces on Windows.

methods.name: GetWifiPHYLayerProtocol
methods.description: Determines Wi-Fi PHY layer protocol based on connection attributes.

methods.name: SetWifiOptions
methods.description: Sets Wi-Fi interface options like scan and streaming mode.

methods.name: GetWifiSSID
methods.description: Retrieves the SSID of the current Wi-Fi connection.
